address: 125 Rama IX Soi 51 Yaek 3, Suan Luang, Suan Luang, Bangkok, 10250, Thailand
bio: For home-style comfort food, this spot with an inviting terrace and air-conditioned interior delivers an authentic Thai experience. The menu features shareable dishes with bold, balanced flavours, making it an ideal option for a meal with friends or family. Highlights include the green curry with beautifully tender pork ribs. Reservations for dinner are recommended....
